title: Body cameras for a fraction of the force
summary: AP reported that DPS was getting body cameras for about 12% of its force.
note: Exact date not confirmed; year per AP context.

title: DPS trooper kills Dion Johnson
summary: A DPS trooper shot and killed Dion Johnson on a Phoenix freeway the same day George Floyd was murdered. DPS troopers had no body cameras at the time.

title: No charges for the trooper
summary: The Maricopa County Attorney's Office declined to charge the trooper, finding his self-defense claim supported.
